potions.name: anonymity potion
potions.good_description: This is a glass vial of gray-colored liquid.  Its odor seems familiar, but you can't quite place a finger on it.
potions.bad_description: This is a glass vial of slightly cloudy gray-colored liquid.  A slight whiff of it is enough to turn your stomach.

potions.name: pungent elixir
potions.good_description: This is a glass vial of red-colored liquid.  It has an extremely pungent odor; one whiff is enough to leave your head spinning.  Not surprisingly, it has a large warning label attached to it.  Apparently, this strange elixir has the power to open all of your mana node links to the maximum, supplying you with an instant burst of mana, but permanently severing one node link.
potions.bad_description: This is a glass vial of slightly cloudy red-colored liquid.  It has an extremely pungent, acrid odor; one whiff is almost enough to make you pass out.  You would be well advised to heed the large warning label and avoid drinking it.
